newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel arrests three PLO police in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Israel arrests three PLO police in West Bank.

text.p: The Israeli army said on Monday it had arrested three Palestinian policemen who were trying to attack a Jewish settlement near the PLO-ruled city of Nablus in the West Bank.
"Security forces arrested this evening three Palestinian policemen during an attempt to carry out a shooting attack on the Har Bracha settlement near Nablus," the army said in a communique.

"During the course of the arrest, one of the Palestinian police was lightly wounded when he tried to shoot towards the security forces. A number of illegal weapons were found in the possession of the Palestinian police," the army said.
Palestinian Authority security forces officials were not available for immediate comment.
The Palestinian territories have been tense since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March, sparking weeks of Palestinian unrest.
